descriptions.w3d_stream_player_new_cue: Allocates and constructs a stream cue and appends it to the player's cue list, growing the list when full.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_remove_cue_801e337c: Stops any channel playing the given cue id and removes that cue from the player's cue list.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_set_output: Replaces the player's output interface, adding a reference to the new one and releasing the old one.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_destroy: Stream cue destructor: releases the attached sample, tears down the base node and optionally frees the memory.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_start: Marks the stream cue as playing and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_stop: Clears the stream cue's playing flag and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_pause: Increments the stream cue's pause depth.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_resume: Decrements the stream cue's pause depth if it is positive.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_is_audible: Returns whether the stream cue is playing and not paused.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_query_sample: Forwards a query to the cue's sample interface, or returns 0 when no sample is attached.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_has_property: Returns whether a property id is 1 or 3, likely the properties a stream cue supports.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_not_implemented_801e367c: Returns the 'not implemented' result code; a stub stream cue method.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_set_float: Sets the cue volume for property 1; reports failure for other properties.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_set_vector: Sets the cue position for property 3 and marks it as positioned; reports failure otherwise.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_not_implemented_801e36ec: Returns the 'not implemented' result code; a stub stream cue method.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_get_float: Reads the sample position at the play cursor (property 24) or the cue volume (property 1).
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_get_vector: Copies the cue position for property 3; returns 'not implemented' otherwise.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_shutdown: Stops an active stream cue and removes it from the current stream player.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_detach: Stops the stream cue and releases its attached sample.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_current_801e3880: Returns the current stream player instance.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_advance_801e3888: Advances the cue's play cursor by the elapsed time while it is playing.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_update_attenuation_801e38: Sets the cue's attenuation to a fixed default and reports it as audible.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_set_channel_parameter: Passes a numbered float parameter to every existing stream channel of the player.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_get_position_set: Returns whether the cue has been given an explicit position.
